build_segmentation_model_edgetam: build a segmentation model using EdgeTamModel to generate masks from input points, boxes, or masks on images
create_image_embeddings_edgetam: create image embeddings from pixel values using EdgeTamModel.get_image_embeddings for memory-efficient mask decoding
encode_prompt_embeddings_edgetam: encode point and box prompts into sparse embeddings using EdgeTamModel.get_prompt_embeddings
run_vision_encoder_edgetam: run the vision encoder via EdgeTamVisionModel to extract FPN feature maps and positional encodings from images
decode_mask_predictions_edgetam: decode mask predictions from image embeddings and prompt embeddings using EdgeTamMaskDecoder.forward
